author: Kənd Həyatı
description:
Juicy chicken roasted over glass jars filled with fresh vegetables creates a truly unique village-style meal 🥕🌿 In this video, we prepare whole chickens with a rustic roasting method that keeps the meat tender while allowing the vegetables underneath to cook in all the delicious juices.

As the chicken slowly roasts, the skin becomes beautifully golden while the meat stays juicy and flavorful. Inside the jars, the vegetables soften and absorb the rich aromas, creating a hearty side dish at the same time.

This jar-roasted chicken is a creative take on traditional countryside cooking — simple ingredients, slow roasting, and plenty of homemade flavor. A satisfying family meal with tender chicken, roasted vegetables, and a beautiful rustic presentation. 🍗🔥🥕
title: Jar-Roasted Chicken with Vegetables | Rustic Village Cooking 🥕🌿
